payload.name: Gallery-based layout visual search efficiency
payload.fact: A gallery-based layout, characterized by a size-based visual hierarchy, supports more efficient visual search in VR menu interfaces compared to a grid-based layout, as evidenced by shorter reaction times, reduced total visit duration, and lower total fixation counts.
payload.boundary: Simulated VR menu interfaces using screen-based eye-tracking.

provenance.title: Eye-Tracking-Based Evaluation of Visual Search Efficiency in Simulated VR Menu Interfaces: Effects of Card Layout Structure and Target Spatial Quadrant
provenance.quote_or_locus: The results showed that the gallery-based layout supported more efficient visual search than the grid-based layout, as reflected in shorter RTs, reduced overall TVD, and lower overall TFC
